text: Add CSV export to the reports page of our Node app. The export must contain exactly the rows currently visible after filters, with a header row. Tests run with npm test.
Users get logged out right after resetting their password. It started last week. Write a prompt for an agent to find and fix it.
Every night, check open dependency-update PRs, merge the ones whose CI is green and that only bump patch versions, and report the rest.

Compare three ways to add full-text search to our Postgres-backed notes app (Postgres tsvector, Meilisearch, OpenSearch). Use three research helpers in parallel, one per option, then combine their findings into a recommendation.
Split the 1,200-line src/billing.js into smaller modules without changing behaviour. Test coverage there is weak.
Migrate our 400 Jest test files to Vitest. Several agents could help, but the suite must stay green.
